+
         if trimmed is None:
             trimmed = self.environment.policies["ext.i18n.trimmed"]
         if trimmed:
@@ -469,6 +471,43 @@ class InternationalizationExtension(Extension):
     def _trim_whitespace(self, string: str, _ws_re: t.Pattern[str] = _ws_re) -> str:
         return _ws_re.sub(" ", string.strip())
 
+    def _validate_trans_variables(
+        self, variables: t.Dict[str, nodes.Expr], parser: "Parser", lineno: int
+    ) -> None:
+        """Validate the variables used in a translation block."""
+        reserved = {"gettext", "ngettext", "pgettext", "npgettext", "_"}
+
+        for name, expr in variables.items():
+            if not name.isidentifier():
+                parser.fail(
+                    f"Invalid variable name {name!r} in translation block."
+                    " Variable names must be valid Python identifiers.",
+                    lineno,
+                    exc=TemplateSyntaxError,
+                )
+
+            if name in reserved:
+                parser.fail(
+                    f"Variable name {name!r} conflicts with translation"
+                    " function names.",
+                    lineno,
+                    exc=TemplateSyntaxError,
+                )
+
+            self._validate_trans_expression(name, expr, parser, lineno)
+
+    def _validate_trans_expression(
+        self, name: str, expr: nodes.Expr, parser: "Parser", lineno: int
+    ) -> None:
+        """Validate a single expression used as a translation variable."""
+        if isinstance(expr, (nodes.TemplateData, nodes.Output)):
+            parser.fail(
+                f"Variable {name!r} uses template data which cannot be used"
+                " in translation contexts.",
+                lineno,
+                exc=TemplateSyntaxError,
+            )
+
     def _parse_block(
         self, parser: "Parser", allow_pluralize: bool
     ) -> t.Tuple[t.List[str], str]:
@@ -636,6 +675,269 @@ class DebugExtension(Extension):
         return pprint.pformat(result, depth=3, compact=True)
 
 
+class ConditionalI18nExtension(Extension):
+    """Adds a ``ctrans`` tag that renders a translation only if a runtime
+    condition is true, and otherwise renders mandatory fallback content.
+
+    .. sourcecode:: jinja
+
+        {% ctrans use_i18n, count %}
+            {{ count }} item
+        {% pluralize %}
+            {{ count }} items
+        {% fallback %}
+            {{ count }} item(s)
+        {% endctrans %}
+    """
+
+    tags = {"ctrans"}
+
+    def parse(self, parser: "Parser") -> t.Union[nodes.Node, t.List[nodes.Node]]:
+        """Parse a conditional translatable tag."""
+        lineno = next(parser.stream).lineno
+        condition = parser.parse_expression()
+        num_called_num = False
+
+        plural_expr: t.Optional[nodes.Expr] = None
+        plural_expr_assignment: t.Optional[nodes.Assign] = None
+        variables: t.Dict[str, nodes.Expr] = {}
+        trimmed = None
+        while parser.stream.current.type != "block_end":
+            # commas are optional separators
+            if parser.stream.skip_if("comma"):
+                continue
+
+            # skip colon for python compatibility
+            if parser.stream.skip_if("colon"):
+                break
+
+            token = parser.stream.expect("name")
+            if token.value in variables:
+                parser.fail(
+                    f"translatable variable {token.value!r} defined twice.",
+                    token.lineno,
+                    exc=TemplateAssertionError,
+                )
+
+            if parser.stream.current.type == "assign":
+                next(parser.stream)
+                variables[token.value] = var = parser.parse_expression()
+            elif trimmed is None and token.value in ("trimmed", "notrimmed"):
+                trimmed = token.value == "trimmed"
+                continue
+            else:
+                variables[token.value] = var = nodes.Name(token.value, "load")
+
+            if plural_expr is None:
+                if isinstance(var, nodes.Call):
+                    plural_expr = nodes.Name("_trans", "load")
+                    variables[token.value] = plural_expr
+                    plural_expr_assignment = nodes.Assign(
+                        nodes.Name("_trans", "store"), var
+                    )
+                else:
+                    plural_expr = var
+                num_called_num = token.value == "num"
+
+        parser.stream.expect("block_end")
+
+        plural = None
+        have_plural = False
+        referenced = set()
+
+        singular_names, sing
